text:
Maria C: Quick sync — proposing staggered sunset for /v1 chat/generate endpoints starting next week. Need owners for traffic slices + SDK aliasing. TL;DR: 1% canary -> 5% -> 25% over 3 weeks; fallback to v1 if compatibility error.

Sanjay: I'll own routing + fallback rules. Opening PR w/ flags & tests. @Maria C can you add list of endpoints that must fallback?

Maria C: thanks — list in runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/api-v1-sunset.md. Also note header negotiation expects X-Api-Version.

Kevin L: I'll take JS SDK shim. Plan: add automatic header + deprecation warning on first call. Any breakage we should block on?

Lara: Eng SRE here — we'll run canaries for Dedicated. Recommend slicing by user_id hash and 1% traffic first day. Need exact rollout windows to lock calendar.

Maria C: Day 0: 1% for 24h, Day 2: 5% for 48h, Day 7: 25% then full. Rollback criteria: error rate > 0.5% or latency increase >200ms.

DevEx Bot: @Kevin L FYI — new audit test template pushed: tools/compat/tests/v1-to-v2-smoke

Kevin L: thx bot. I'll add a unit test that asserts 'x-api-version' header present and that SDK falls back on 409 responses.

Sanjay: PR opened: github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4123 — note: changed routing tag keys. Ping for reviews.

Maria C: assigning owners: routing=Sanjay, JS SDK=Kevin L, canary=Eng SRE (Lara), docs=DocsTeam (cc @maya). Please update PRs and drop checkpoints here. :thumbsup:

Lara: locking schedule in calendar and will post canary monitor dashboard link once live.

maya: Docs drafted — migration guide skeleton ready, need examples for Python and Node. Will sync with Kevin for snippets.

Maria C: any blockers? If none, we'll cut the first canary on Tue 09:00 UTC.

Kevin L: no blockers from SDK side. Will open canary-ready PR by EOD Mon.

Sanjay: minor router lint failing on staging; fixing now.

Maria C: awesome, keep updates here. If you want async approvals, add `/approve` in PR and I'll follow up.

DeployBot: staging deploy successful for routing-pr at 1767457000 :rocket:

Sanjay: staging lint fixed and deployed.

Kevin L: PR opened: github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/789 — includes header shim and tests.

Maria C: sweet. Last call — anyone else? Otherwise schedule stands.

Lara: green from SRE side.

Maria C: thanks everyone :raised_hands:
